title: ZeraCobble Modpack
description: ZeraCobble ensures a mix between vanilla Minecraft and Cobblemon, making an experience you'll expect if Cobblemon was a real game! It enables a few vanilla tweaks, such as and also some Cobblemon ones. (Also this is my first modpack.)
body:
**ZeraCobble** ensures a mix between v**anilla Minecraft and Cobblemon**, making an experience you'll expect if Cobblemon was a real game! It **does enable a few vanilla tweaks and also some Cobblemon ones.** (Also this is my first modpack.)
